## Checklist

- [ ] Official API only (no cookies / scrapers)
- [ ] No fake analytics; unknown provider state is not a success
- [ ] Tenant boundary preserved if schema is touched
- [ ] Publish / idempotency considered if this can mutate a network
- [ ] I can explain every hunk (including AI-assisted hunks)
- [ ] CLA signed, or I am a `scriora` org member

CI: this repo’s checks only. Cloud deploys are not required.
